publicationNote: Keep all source, attribution and licence links. Two photographs are embedded: the public-domain nineteen-year-old portrait and Udimu’s unmodified 17 May 2016 house photograph under CC BY-SA 4.0. Four short WebExhibits English excerpts are typeset under the reuse terms recorded here, with CC BY-SA 1.0 applied to the panels. Original relationship and household cards replace the locket and insurance photographs; they are reading aids, not archives. The scholarly edition’s facsimiles and full translations, Tom Parsons and Claire Zhao photographs, locket and Jacquet reproduction remain source references; their redistribution permission is not assumed.
